_comment: E911 points still classified FIRE STATION that are not fire stations any more, confirmed on the ground. Keyed by ESITEID so refreshing locations.geojson from VCGI cannot silently reintroduce them. Add an entry rather than editing locations.geojson, so the reason stays on the record.

excluded.reason: Now a food shelf. E911 record dates from 1998 (MAPYEAR 1998-01-01).

Former South Hero station; the department operates from 131 COMMUNITY LN. Note this E911 record is recent (MAPYEAR 2026-02-03), so the layer is not stale here — it still classifies the old building as a fire station.

Colchester Water Department, Fire District No. 2 — a water utility, not a fire station. In Vermont a 'fire district' is a municipal water/services district, so E911 may be classifying these by name; worth watching for others.

Not a fire station — a small single-bay building on Ethan Allen Ave. Record dates from 1998 but was touched as recently as 2025-04-18, so a recent UPDATEDATE is no guarantee the SITETYPE was rechecked.
